comment: VD Part 3: the spark is the player's strongest Vector, found by the quiz in data/intro/spark_quiz.json (or chosen directly once the Journal unlocks it). It raises that Vector's affinity (affinityBoost, added with a Vector blend), grants it as a known Vector, adds its first card to the deck and gives a small trait (data/traits.json, "spark": true). Icons and reveal art go by asset id.

sparks.name: A spark of Heat
sparks.reveal: Heat. Of course it's Heat. You've been running warm since the truck pulled in.

sparks.name: A spark of Cold
sparks.reveal: Cold. Calm, slow, patient. The town's going to hate how calm you are.

sparks.name: A spark of Force
sparks.reveal: Force. You push. Doors, people, your luck. Mostly doors.

sparks.name: A spark of Motion
sparks.reveal: Motion. You were halfway out the door before the question ended.

sparks.name: A spark of Binding
sparks.reveal: Binding. You hold on. To boxes, to people, to grudges.

sparks.name: A spark of Light
sparks.reveal: Light. You notice things. That'll be useful here. And dangerous.
